~start_node_property_change_description: The change in reactor temperature R-201 setpoint is a system-level change in the FCC Unit, and its effects spread over several interrelated regions. Reactor temperature change has a direct impact on reaction kinetics in the Reactor-Riser and consequently the catalyst activity, regenerator heat equilibrium and the subsequent separation of product downstream in the Fractionation section. This interdependency brings about the element of complexity since changes in temperature can affect the feed conversion efficiency, distribution of product yield and stability in operation. ~start_node_property_lessons_learned: Improved yield with stable thermal control
~start_node_property_change_description: The change in reactor temperature R-201 setpoint is a system-level change in the FCC Unit, and its effects spread over several interrelated regions. Reactor temperature change has a direct impact on reaction kinetics in the Reactor-Riser and consequently the catalyst activity, regenerator heat equilibrium and the subsequent separation of product downstream in the Fractionation section. This interdependency brings about the element of complexity since changes in temperature can affect the feed conversion efficiency, distribution of product yield and stability in operation. Besides, the change also affects control loops that control temperature, flow, and pressure, which enhances the chances of coupled system responses.
~start_node_property_system_impacts: Directly impacts catalyst activity and coke formation. Influences regenerator load via coke burn-off. Affects downstream product distribution in fractionator. Interacts with air blower and combustion control system.
~start_node_property_reason: Need to improve catalyst activity and process efficiency
~end_node_property_reason: Validation before operating at new conditions
~end_node_property_justification: Validation of new setpoint and system stability before full operation
~end_node_property_outcome: All checks passed - setpoint validated within safe limits

~start_node_property_lessons_learned: Enhanced temperature control after tuning stabilization
~start_node_property_change_description: The modification of the FV-103 control valve to a smart control valve will enhance the temperature regulation process in the feed heater. The change will also bring about advanced control such as remote control and improved feedback accuracy.

~start_node_property_reason: Inconsistent control performance and need for improved temperature stability
~end_node_property_text: Enhanced temperature control after tuning stabilization
